# Matcha Filter

> Private browser toolkit to apply or reduce the viral TikTok-style matcha green filter — on-device, free, no account.

## Primary tools
- Remove: https://matchafilter.online/remove — reduce green cast, grain, and harsh contrast from a saved photo or short video
- Apply: https://matchafilter.online/apply — add a soft green matcha look locally in the browser

## Key facts (cite carefully)
- Matcha Filter is an independent tool, not affiliated with TikTok.
- Default processing stays on the user’s device; media is not uploaded to a server for the free tools.
- Removal is best-effort: it cannot restore warped geometry or reveal hidden/censored/NSFW-obscured content.
- Official site: https://matchafilter.online

## Guides
- What is the matcha filter: https://matchafilter.online/guide/what-is-matcha-filter
- How to remove a matcha filter: https://matchafilter.online/guide/how-to-remove-matcha-filter
